items.title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
items.title_zh: 谷歌从Chrome应用商店移除MV2扩展，包括uBlock Origin
items.title_en: Google Removes MV2 Extensions, Including uBlock Origin, from Chrome Web Store
items.summary: Google has removed Manifest V2 extensions, including uBlock Origin, from the Chrome Web Store, sparking widespread user concern over ad blocking and browser control.

items.title: Internet centralization and the original sin of NAT
items.title_zh: Linux NAT 实现者反思：NAT 如何侵蚀开放互联网
items.title_en: Linux NAT implementer reflects on how NAT eroded the open internet
items.summary: A personal reflection by the implementer of Linux NAT argues that NAT's design contributed to internet centralization by eroding public endpoints and shaping client-server assumptions.

items.title: Sliding-window attention beats linear on long-context reasoning [R]
items.title_zh: 滑窗注意力在长上下文推理上胜过线性注意力
items.title_en: Sliding-Window Attention Outperforms Linear Attention on Long-Context Reasoning
items.summary: A new preprint reports that sliding-window attention with sinks substantially outperforms linear attention variants on long-context reasoning benchmarks like Needle-in-a-Haystack and BABILong.

items.title: Your GNN is probably just an overcomplicated MLP (Tabular Leakage). We built SynthFin-AML to enforce strict causal boundaries. [P]
items.title_zh: GNN存在时间泄漏，SynthFin-AML强制因果划分
items.title_en: GNNs Leak Future Edges; SynthFin-AML Enforces Causal Splits
items.summary: The post highlights temporal leakage in GNN training on dynamic graphs and introduces SynthFin-AML, a synthetic dataset designed to enforce strict causal evaluation boundaries.

items.title: 🤖 Claude 共享链接遭搜索引擎索引 大量用户隐私外泄  Claude 的共享对话功能出现严重隐私漏洞。
items.title_zh: Claude 共享对话遭搜索引擎收录 敏感数据面临泄露
items.title_en: Claude Shared Chats Leak Sensitive Data via Search Engine Indexing
items.summary: Claude's shared conversation links are being indexed by search engines, exposing sensitive user data such as API keys and personal information.

items.title: OpenClaw 发布史上最大更新 2.0，汇集逾 1.6 万个拉取请求
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 发布重大 2.0 更新，合并逾 1.6 万个拉取请求
items.title_en: OpenClaw Releases Landmark 2.0, Merging Over 16,000 Pull Requests
items.summary: OpenClaw shipped its largest update ever, version 2.0, incorporating over 16,000 pull requests from 933 contributors and overhauling installation, browser experience, and cloud collaboration.

items.title: 欧盟认定 ChatGPT、Reddit、Roblox 为超大型服务，三者面临更严数字监管
items.title_zh: 欧盟依据《数字服务法》认定ChatGPT、Reddit和Roblox为“超大型”在线服务
items.title_en: EU Designates ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox as 'Very Large' Online Services Under DSA
items.summary: EU designates ChatGPT, Reddit, and Roblox as very large online services under the Digital Services Act, imposing stricter safety, auditing, and data-sharing obligations.

items.title: 📱 小米发布三款玄戒新芯片，AI 旗舰 SoC 将首搭小米 18 Fold  小米宣布新一代玄戒芯片发布，包括 AI 旗舰 SoC 玄戒 O3、1.22 TB/
items.title_zh: 小米发布玄戒O3芯片及两款AI芯片，首发支持LPDDR6
items.title_en: Xiaomi unveils Xuanjie O3 SoC plus two AI chips, first mobile chip with LPDDR6
items.summary: Xiaomi announces three new Xuanjie chips (AI flagship SoC, AI accelerator, and 3nm automotive AI chip) covering end-side AI needs across mobile, vehicle, and home.
